note: Gate for controlcenter_invoke. mode 'open' allows every tool of a discoverable server; mode 'allowlist' requires a matching allow rule. deny always wins. 'server' and 'tool' accept '*' wildcards. A malformed file refuses every invocation instead of falling back to allow-all.
allowedRemoteHostsNote: Empty means any HTTPS host. Plain HTTP is refused unless the host is loopback, regardless of this list. Entries may start with '*.' to match subdomains.
redactResultsNote: Recursive redaction of forwarded results. Set to false only if a caller needs byte-exact payloads; that is a deliberate weakening.
